assumptions: The source theorem assumes a simple q-regular graph, rank-q local frame matrices, and nonzero squared singular values uniformly in [alpha,beta] with alpha > 0.
The Green-diagonal theorem additionally assumes the scalar constraint matrix K is positive definite.
The uniform-family equivalence is stated for fixed q and uniform positive local frame bounds.

contract.interface: For a symmetric graph-supported matrix H and supplied probe rows X, the source defines kappa_op = sup ||H||_op / ||HX||_F. Under its stated assumptions it bounds kappa_op^2 using the maximum diagonal entry g of K^-1 and gives an exact decoder using local lifting plus one sparse n-variable solve.
